title: 10. Exercises: Data Structures — Advanced
objectives: Solve the Data Structures — Advanced exercises without looking at the lesson
Test edge cases and explain your approach

sections.title: Exercises
sections.body:
### Basic Exercises (1-10)
- List operations and manipulations
- Tuple unpacking and use cases
- Set operations and applications
- Dictionary methods and patterns

### Intermediate Exercises (11-20)
- Data analysis and processing
- Performance comparisons
- Real-world data structure applications
- Nested structure manipulations

### Advanced Exercises (21-27)
- **LRU Cache Implementation**: Design efficient caching system
- **Trie Implementation**: Build prefix tree for string operations
- **Memory-Efficient Processor**: Handle large datasets with minimal memory
- **Custom Hash Table**: Implement hash table with collision handling
- **Performance Benchmark**: Compare data structure performance
- **Graph Algorithms**: Implement graph traversal and analysis
- **Data Structure Factory**: Choose optimal structures based on usage patterns
